content_sections.heading: APPSC Group-I Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for APPSC Group-I Services consists of three stages: a Screening Test, a Mains (Written) Examination, and an Interview. The Screening Test is held offline in OMR-based objective format and is used to shortlist candidates for the Mains examination. Negative marking applies: 1/3rd of the marks allotted to a question is deducted for each wrong answer. The Interview carries 75 marks. The final selection is based on the aggregate of Mains papers I to V (750 marks) plus the Interview (75 marks), taking the total marks for merit to 825. The Telugu and English papers in the Mains are of qualifying nature only and are not counted in this total.

faq.question: Q1. What is APPSC Group-I Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a direct recruitment drive by the Andhra Pradesh Public Service Commission, announced via Brief Notification No. 07/2026 dated 15/09/2026, to fill 163 provisional vacancies across 13 categories of posts under Group-I Services.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in APPSC Group-I Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: 163 provisional vacancies are notified across 13 post categories, including Deputy Collector, Assistant Commissioner of State Tax, Deputy Superintendent of Police, and others. These numbers are subject to variation upon confirmation from the concerned departments.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for APPSC Group-I Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 27/10/2026, up to 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for APPSC Group-I posts?
faq.answer: Most posts require a Bachelor's Degree from a recognised university. Post Code 04 (DSP Communications) requires a B.E./B.Tech in Electronics & Communication/Telecommunication/Radio Engineering. Candidates must hold the qualification as on the date of the Detailed Notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for APPSC Group-I Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is not specified in the brief notification and will be announced in the Detailed Notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for APPSC Group-I Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is not specified in the brief notification. It will be published along with the Detailed Notification.
